relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: one mAb blocks CGRP signaling by binding to the CGRP receptor and the other by targeting the ligand directly

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-mAbs block CGRP signaling not only at the CGRP receptor but also at the amylin 1 (AMY1) receptor

key_findings: Switching from erenumab to galcanezumab or fremanezumab gave a >=30% response in 32% of 25 erenumab non-responders.
No patient with daily headache responded to the switch, whereas 50% of non-daily headache patients did.
